## Verification

- [ ] Unit/integration tests added or updated.
- [ ] python -m unittest discover -s tests -v passes.
- [ ] python -m compileall -q repoguard tests passes.
- [ ] CLI/GUI behavior manually checked where relevant.
- [ ] README, CHANGELOG and GUI_TESTING.md updated where relevant.

## Safety

- [ ] No real credentials, private keys, personal data or local machine paths included.
- [ ] No new network calls, telemetry, uploads or automatic repository modifications.
- [ ] No runtime dependencies added without discussion.
- [ ] Any secret-detection fixtures use synthetic values built from fragments.
